summary: Lesson Notes feature tested end-to-end. Backend 10/10 pytest pass (upsert, empty-text delete, 404 unknown lesson/path, 401 unauth, per-user isolation student vs admin, path_id filter, md export with #/##/### headings, pdf export incl. HTML/script/unicode chars, 404 when none, 422 bad format, 422 >20000 chars). Frontend: enroll via academy-enroll-384eef11de47 works; lesson-notes inside lesson-view; status 'saving…' -> 'saved'; reload keeps text; path soc-fundamentals lesson switching keeps per-lesson notes and quick edit (150ms before switch) is flushed and kept; course My Notes tab lists only that course's notes, search filters, PDF/MD downloads fire with proper filenames; sidebar nav-my-notes -> /app/notes groups by course with correct notes-open links, search, downloads; empty state + disabled download buttons; mobile 390 no horizontal overflow. One real bug found: stale pending edit.

minor.issue: format check happens after the notes lookup, so format=xyz returns 404 (not 422) for users with no notes
Doesn't check enrollment/purchase. Any logged-in user can save notes on lessons of paid or unenrolled courses, and the list then shows those lesson titles. Low risk.
Filename slug can contain double dashes (notes-soc-analyst-interview-preparation--100--q-a-...). Cosmetic only.

ui_bugs.issue: If a user types and then undoes the change back to the saved text within 800ms, the stale pending edit is still saved when they switch lessons or unmount. The status also stays stuck on 'saving…'. Reproduced: note 'TEST_ L1 note', typed 'Z' then Backspace, switched lesson, and the server stored 'TEST_ L1 noteZ'. Cause: in the [text] effect, the early return `if (text === saved.current) return` doesn't clear pending.current or reset the status. Fix: in that branch set pending.current = null and setSt('saved' or 'idle').

issues: The 'open course →' link wraps onto 3 lines next to a long course title. Add whitespace-nowrap/shrink-0.

critical_code_review_comments: routes_notes.collect calls find_path once per distinct path. Fine for now; to_list(2000) caps the notes silently.
LessonNotes fetches every note for the path on each lesson switch to find one lesson. Fine for now, but a per-lesson GET would be lighter.
PDF generation runs in a threadpool and escapes user text correctly (verified with <script>, & and unicode).
